emerging_technology: Agentic AI systems: an integrated language model, model-selected tools, observations, permissions and human stopping authority for bounded multi-step digital work. This is the system under analysis, not a single model, chart plugin or all of generative AI.
intended_application: A proposed human-supervised chart-review workflow: compare business charts and claims with approved source tables using read-only tools, then draft corrections for a named human reviewer. No autonomous publication or financial/customer decisions.
business_need: Investigate whether review effort can be reduced while maintaining source traceability and correct interpretation.
management_question: Even if a scoped adoption/learning decision is strategically appropriate, can this organization absorb, govern and sustain agentic chart review? Separate readiness for isolated learning from readiness for routine use; identify prioritized changes, accountable roles and missing evidence.
time_horizon: Four-week readiness assessment/remediation planning window; examine the next quarter of recurring operation and review quarterly. No promised deployment date.
additional_context:
Lab7 constructed teaching case, not real organization, pilot or authorization. Continue TW7 chart-review scope and baseline current DEFER decision. Technology/application fit is UNVALIDATED and comparative net advantage UNKNOWN in ALL cases; no technical, value or market evidence changes across organizational profiles. Readiness advice cannot override Adoption Agent choice or grant permission. The capabilities_constraints field is the complete current organizational evidence for each case; explicit contrast replacements supersede baseline unknowns only in that case. Distinguish absent evidence from demonstrated lack. A role required by policy is not an appointed/funded role. Do not infer culture, AI skills, sponsor commitment or budget from firm size, conservative posture or BI experience. External legal, product-version or price claims are not needed to decide the teaching-case readiness. C3 page36 also asks for a concise conditional PoC/use-case design; propose it without executing or claiming it proves readiness. Fixed source packet:

organization: Hypothetical mid-sized United States financial-services firm
industry_sector: Regulated financial services and internal management reporting.
users_stakeholders: Business analysts, analytics managers, model-risk staff, compliance reviewers, information-security staff, executives who consume reports, and customers indirectly affected by management decisions.
adoption_posture: Conservative and risk-averse. Requires matched evidence and a credible best-baseline comparison before committing to agent learning; general willingness to consider pilots is not project authorization.
capabilities_constraints: HYPOTHETICAL SCOPED LEARNING APPROVAL, not a real event: sponsor and security/model-risk authority have approved one isolated public/synthetic-only read-only chart-agent POC for four weeks, with no sensitive/production data, autonomous publication or financial/customer decisions. No routine-use approval exists. This only supplies permission and an allowed environment; it does not establish staff readiness, budget capacity or application feasibility. FICTIONAL PREPARED ORGANIZATIONAL PROFILE: a named-role reporting sponsor signs the POC charter and accepts accountability; a reporting service owner and deputy have agreed duty/cover and authority to stop. Two BI reviewers and one platform maintainer have protected POC time within a confirmed 24-hour total cap, including checking and support; the finance owner confirms the cap and a funded next-quarter recurring support line with a stated review date. Reviewers have completed source-trace/error-escalation exercises with recorded competency checks, including ordinary users. A workflow dry run records handoff, reviewer publication sign-off, exception queue and manual fallback. Security confirms sandbox isolation, approved model/tool route, least-privilege read-only input, lineage and test logs; the route is not production qualification. The risk owner signs access/incident/change controls and an exercise records stop, escalation and restore to manual review. Analyst representatives have reviewed workload and agreed to participate; dissent/feedback channel and nonpunitive error reporting are documented. Monthly review of capacity/cost/incidents and model/data changes has an assigned owner. These are fictional organizational evidence premises, not actual accomplishments or an agent accuracy/value study. No representative application performance results, incremental benefit or routine release authority are supplied.
risk_consequence_context: A fabricated claim, incorrect denominator, privacy breach, or misleading visual could affect executive decisions, regulatory obligations, and reputation. Drafts are reversible, but distribution of an incorrect report can have material consequences.
